trimmedBy: node trim-ats-b-captures.mjs (JSON.parse, whole-record selection by record predicate (the first remote job, the first with an empty employment_type, the first with two locations, the first plain on-site full-time job), regex redaction of e-mail addresses and separator-bearing phone numbers inside string values, JSON.stringify, prettier); never a byte cut
notes: Hire Fellows: 23 jobs captured (21 on-site full-time, 1 remote, 1 on-site with employment_type ""), 3 kept: the one remote job (which is also the only one with several locations: six countries), the one with an empty employment type and an empty department, and a plain on-site full-time job. OWNERSHIP VERIFIED, EVIDENCE: PAYLOAD_FIELD (the envelope name is "Hire Fellows"). Envelope: {name, description, jobs[]}; name is the account (employer) name as Workable holds it. ENDPOINT: the documented public form is https://www.workable.com/api/accounts/{subdomain}?details=true (Workable help center, which gives no field list, no rate limit and no terms for it); it answers HTTP 302 to https://apply.workable.com/api/v1/widget/accounts/{subdomain}?details=true (measured 2026-10-24, Location header), which is the address captured here and the only one the adapter calls, so the adapter has no need of a redirect (the page loop never reads Location; whether a transport follows one is the transport setting, pinned by the declared host of the adapter). The sibling https://apply.workable.com/api/v1/accounts/{subdomain} is the career-page account document (id, uid, logo, languages, details.overview) and carries no jobs. robots.txt: apply.workable.com is "User-agent: * / Disallow:" (empty, so nothing is disallowed) with "Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no"; www.workable.com disallows only /user_password_resets, /admin, /auth/google and /j/ and carries the same content signal. Workable's terms (https://www.workable.com/terms, 2026-03-02) are written for customers; they contain no clause on automated access to public job data. The authenticated API https://{subdomain}.workable.com/spi/v3/ (bearer token) is a separate integration and was not called. The widget lists jobs only for accounts that publish them there: of 37 account slugs probed on 2026-10-24, 3 listed jobs (huggingface, hirefellows, flosum), 27 answered 200 with "jobs":[] (Hotjar, Deel, Typeform, Wise...) and 7 answered 404, so an empty list is common and is not a dead board. E-mail addresses and phone numbers inside string values were replaced by a parser; personal NAMES in free-text descriptions cannot be found by a parser and were not redacted.
